node.statement: Using node 1.1 only after it is validated, ||XY tensor (I_A^2-I_A)||_n=||XY|| ||I_A^2-I_A||<=||X||||Y|| epsilon||I_A||<=epsilon(1+epsilon)||X||||Y||<=2epsilon||X||||Y|| when epsilon<=1/2. It does not prove that an extended epsilon-C*-algebra satisfies the added hypotheses; that missing implication requires definitions not registered in this workspace.
